name: pnp-powerplatform-prompts-multilingual-support-router
title: Multilingual Support Router
shortDescription: Detects language, classifies, scores urgency, extracts entities, and generates a same-language acknowledgment reply for customer support tickets — returned as strict JSON.
longDescription: This AI Builder prompt processes incoming support tickets in any language and returns a structured JSON object with detected language (ISO 639-1), category (Billing/Technical/Account/General), urgency (Critical/High/Normal/Low), extracted entities (product, error code, account ID), and a customer acknowledgment reply written in the same language as the ticket. The strict JSON-only output integrates directly with Power Automate Parse JSON actions.

metadata.value: Analyze this [support_ticket] and detect language, classify, assess urgency, extract entities, and generate a same-language reply. Return as JSON.
